source: Original — generic bodyweight conditioning exercises authored for Coach Tools. Not transcribed from a specific published programme.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.cue: Sit back like there's a chair behind you, chest up, knees over toes.

exercises.name: Forward Lunges
exercises.cue: Step forward and drop the back knee gently towards the floor.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
exercises.cue: Step backwards this time, keep your front knee steady over your ankle.

exercises.name: Squat Jumps
exercises.cue: Squat down then explode up into a jump, land soft and quiet.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.cue: Rise up tall onto your tiptoes, then lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.cue: Slide down the wall until your knees make a right angle and hold.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.cue: Squeeze your bottom and lift your hips up towards the ceiling.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance
exercises.cue: Stand tall on one foot — see how long you can hold it still.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.cue: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels as you lower.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.cue: Bend your elbows straight back behind you, not out to the sides.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
exercises.cue: Keep your hips still and tap the opposite shoulder with each hand.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.cue: Lift your chest and legs together, squeeze your back, hold for two.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.cue: Small circles first, then bigger — forwards, then backwards.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Straight line from shoulders to heels, tummy pulled in tight.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.cue: Stack your hips and shoulders, lift up tall through your waist.

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.cue: Curl your chest up towards your knees, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.cue: Lean back slightly and rotate side to side, touching the floor each time.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.cue: Bring opposite elbow to opposite knee in a smooth pedalling motion.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.cue: Keep your legs straight and lower them slowly without your back arching.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.cue: Reach opposite arm and leg out long, keep your hips dead still.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.cue: Arms and legs out together, then back in — keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Star Jumps
exercises.cue: Jump up wide like a star, land soft with bent knees.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.cue: Squat, kick back to a plank, then jump up tall to finish.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.cue: Drive your knees in towards your chest one at a time, quick and controlled.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.cue: Pump your knees up to hip height, land lightly on your toes.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.cue: Hands and feet only, knees hovering just off the floor as you crawl.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
exercises.cue: Hands and feet on the floor, tummy up — walk forwards or sideways.

exercises.name: Skipping on the Spot
exercises.cue: Light, bouncy steps — imagine a rope going under your feet.

exercises.name: Tuck Jumps
exercises.cue: Jump up and bring your knees towards your chest, land soft.

exercises.name: Squat to Press
exercises.cue: Squat down, then stand and reach both arms straight up high.

exercises.name: Speed Skaters
exercises.cue: Bound side to side, land on one foot and stay balanced.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.cue: Walk your hands out to a plank, then walk your feet back up to meet them.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.cue: Hands on hips, make big smooth circles one way then the other.

exercises.name: Arm Swings
exercises.cue: Swing both arms across your body and back out wide.

exercises.name: Ankle Bounces
exercises.cue: Small quick bounces on the balls of your feet, light and springy.

exercises.name: Torso Twists
exercises.cue: Rotate your top half side to side, keep your hips facing forward.
